import { type JsonObject, type JsonValue } from '@omne-harness-lite/content-blocks';
/** Consume the released strict JSON boundary, with no caller-data mutation. */
export declare function jsonValue(value: unknown): JsonValue | undefined;
export declare function isObject(value: unknown): value is JsonObject;
export declare function isStringArray(value: unknown): value is readonly string[];
